title: Best of Kazakhstan and Azerbaijan with FREE Koke Tobe Cable Car Ride
highlights: Discover the diverse cultural landscapes of Kazakhstan and Azerbaijan, from ancient monuments to modern vibrancy and scenic natural backdrops.
Explore Panfilov Park in Almaty, home to the vibrant Zenkov Cathedral, a rare example of a wooden building from the tsarist era.
Ski or snowboard at Shymbulak Ski Resort, Central Asia's top destination for winter sports, set in the stunning Zailiysky Alatau mountain range.
Step into Juma Mosque in Baku, a historic gem dating back to the 11th century, offering a serene atmosphere and stunning Islamic architecture to admire.
inclusions: Transfer from Almaty International Airport to Super Deluxe Hotel

know_before_you_go: All visitors are required to carry valid ID proof.
Meals in the restaurants or cafes are not included.
Please be aware that the package does not cover the cost of the visa, which must be obtained separately.
Travel insurance is not included in the package.
Kindly note that personal expenses are not included in the package and should be budgeted separately.
Any activities or transfers not specified in the itinerary are not part of the package and require separate arrangements.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Almaty
days.desc: Welcome to Almaty! After your arrival at the Almaty International Airport, you will be driven to your pre-booked hotel for check-in. You can relax at the hotel for a while and later head out to explore Almaty on your own. You can explore the Zelyony Bazaar, Abai Square and more such places to learn about the local culture, cuisine and crafts. Later, you will return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Almaty City Tour
days.desc: Today, you will board your transfer to Panfilov Park, a delightful space of lush greenery. Here, you'll explore the stunning Zenkov Cathedral, known for its wooden construction. Later in the day, your city tour continues to Republic Square to admire the Independence Monument and watch a stunning sunset. Following this, you will be driven back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Medeu Ice Skating Rink and Shymbulak Ski Resort
days.desc: In the morning, you will board your transfer to Medeu, where you'll feel the thrill of skating at one of the largest alpine rinks. Following this, you will enjoy a picturesque cable car journey to Shymbulak Ski Resort. Nestled at approximately 2,200 meters, Shymbulak presents spectacular views of snow-covered mountains and untouched valleys, creating an ideal setting for relaxation. Later, you will be driven back to the hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

items.title: Day Trip to Medeu Ice Skating Rink & Shymbulak Ski Resort

days.title: Day Trip to Green Bazaar & Rahat Chocolate Factory | Visit to Kok Tobe Park
days.desc: Board your transfer to the Green Bazaar, where you can indulge in a shopping spree for souvenirs, clothing, and local snacks. Next, explore the Rahat Chocolate Factory, where you will see how chocolate is made and have the chance to sample some treats. Following this, you will hop on a scenic cable car ride to Kok Tobe Park, where you can enjoy various amusement rides and panoramic views of the surrounding landscape. Afterwards, you will be driven back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Trip to Green Bazaar & Rakhat Chocolate Factory, Almaty

days.title: Transfer to Baku from Almaty
days.desc: After check out from the hotel, you will get transferred to the Almaty International airport for your flight to Baku (flight not included in the tour package). Upon arrival at the Heydar Aliyev Airport, you will be driven to your pre-booked hotel in Baku. Check-in and relax for the day. You can choose to explore the city at your own pace, and visit the Baku Eye, Teze Pir Mosque and other such attractions. Later, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Baku Old City Tour | Absheron Peninsula Tour
days.desc: In the morning, board your transfer for a tour of Baku's old city, visiting the Maiden Tower and the Shirvanshahs Palace. You will also explore the National Carpet Museum & National History Museum, enjoy a ride on the funicular, and take a leisurely walk along the Boulevard. Next, you will get transferred to the Absheron Peninsula to visit iconic sites like Yanardag, Ateshgah Temple, Mardakan Castle, and the Heydar Aliyev Center. Later, you'll be driven back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Gabala and Tufandag Mountain
days.desc: In the morning, you will board your transfer to Gabala and visit the famous Nohur Lake, where you can enjoy boating (at extra expense) or simply relax by the shore. Next, ascend to Tufandag using the world's longest cable car, capturing the breathtaking mountain views. Continue your day at Gabalaland, an entertaining theme park, offering thrilling activities such as karting and an ice rink. Afterwards, you'll be driven back to the hotel in Baku for an overnight stay.

items.title: Day Trip to Gabala and Tufandag Mountain from Baku

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: After checking out from your hotel, you will be driven to the Heydar International Airport for your flight back home. This marks the end of your Azerbaijan trip.
